note: The tools the desktop app carries (faust, ninja) or fetches on the member's Mac (cmake, juce), each pinned to one release at its official address with the SHA-256 GitHub publishes for it. desktop/scripts/build-faust.sh reads faust and ninja when the app is packaged; src-tauri/src/tools.rs compiles cmake and juce in. faust.version must be library/faust-versions.json's native.faust and juce.version the JUCE_VERSION of shell/build.sh; tests hold both.
